raw_segments.text: Bold adventurers soon penetrate into the country the Indians have deserted, and when they have
advanced about 15 or 20 legs from the extreme frontiers of the whites, they begin to build
habitations for civilized beings in the midst of the wilderness.
This is done without difficulty, as the territory of a hunting nation is ill-defined.
It is the common property of the tribe, and belongs to no one in particular, so that individual
interests are not concerned in the protection of any part of it.
